messages:
Lina (People Ops): Hey everyone — quick note: All-Hands next Wednesday 10:00am PT in Auditorium A + Zoom. Please read agenda below and drop any Qs in this thread by EOD Monday so we can prioritize. :calendar:

Lina (People Ops): Agenda (30m total):
• 10:00 — Exec update (Ava) 10m
• 10:10 — Product highlights + demo (Priya) 8m
• 10:18 — Infra & incidents summary (Marcus + Santiago) 6m
• 10:24 — Hiring snapshot & org changes (Lina) 4m
• 10:28 — Q&A / closing 2m

Lina (People Ops): We’ll record and post the recording, plus a one-pager takeaways. If you need a slot for a 2-min demo, ping me.

Ava (CEO): High level we’ll call out roadmap bets and funding runway — aiming for brevity. If there’s a strategic ask you want highlighted, add it here.

Priya (Head of Product): I’ll demo the new rollout flow for Dedicated customers. If you have specific metrics you want surfaced (latency, cost delta), mention them here.

Marcus (VP Eng): Adding infra/incident summary: Santiago and I will recap the recent autoscaler regression and mitigation timeline. If you have specific customer impacts to flag, drop a quick note.

Santiago (Eng SRE): TL;DR we rolled a throttling fix and reverted the problematic autoscale commit; patch went live last Fri. I’ll bring a 3-slide postmortem and next steps for monitoring.

Joon (Marketing): We’ll share the customer-facing post next week. If Product wants a quote, DM me.

Lina (People Ops): People Ops updates: two new IC hires starting Apr 1 (ENG + ML infra), updated parental leave policy FAQ will be linked in the follow-up doc.

Someone: Quick Q — can we expand the Q&A time if we get more questions?

Lina (People Ops): We’ll triage here and keep the live Q&A focused; overflow questions will be answered asynchronously in the follow-up doc.

Priya (Head of Product): Question for Marcus/Santiago — will the autoscaler fix change default burst limits for Dedicated tenants?

Marcus (VP Eng): Short answer: no change to defaults today; we exposed a knob for opt-in burst tuning, will document.

Ava (CEO): Also planning to call out a small org rename in Product to reflect Support alignment. Will post details in the notes.

Lina (People Ops): Submissions: please add questions or short bullet points by Monday 5pm PT. We’ll pin an agenda slide deck Friday afternoon. :pushpin:

OpsBot: Reminder: All-Hands calendar event updated (Wed 10:00am PT).

--- (Meeting happened) ---

Lina (People Ops): Thanks all — recording and notes posted. Recording: https://redwood-internal/recordings/2923456789-spring-sync.mp4

Lina (People Ops): One-pager takeaways:
• Exec: runway extended + focus on Dedicated expansion into EU.
• Product: rollout flow demo — initial cohort in staging next week, expected cost reduction ~12% for batching-heavy workloads.
• Infra: autoscaler regression postmortem — root cause was a race in leader election; fix deployed, added canary + alerting.
• Hiring: 2 new ICs joining Apr 1; hiring freeze lifted for critical roles.
• Policy: parental leave FAQ updated (link in doc).

Priya (Head of Product): Action: product to share rollout checklist by Fri.

Santiago (Eng SRE): Action: we’ll add a circuit-breaker dashboard and annotation for the autoscale alerts by EOW.

Marcus (VP Eng): Thanks to the oncall and release teams for the quick turnaround.

Ava (CEO): Appreciated. Small ask for folks: keep using the incident playbook and surface any customer-visible anomalies ASAP.

Joon (Marketing): Posting the customer blog plan next week; internal Qs welcome.

Lina (People Ops): Follow-up doc (slides + notes + recording) here: https://redwood-internal/notes/2923456789-spring-sync-note.md — will pin in #all-hands and email summary.

Someone: Thanks, useful recap.

Lina (People Ops): Closing: if you asked a question in the thread and haven’t seen an answer, DM me and I’ll follow up with the right owner. :heart:
